description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-12 DIRECT-MYSQL CRUD MIGRATION: companies/branches/stores/customers/suppliers/marketplaceProducts commit ONLY through the existing v2_* + entity atomic MySQL endpoints (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE straight into companies/stores/products/customers/suppliers tables) via a diffed single-record delta (addCompany = ~0.5KB POST, no 13.4KB state-blob flush, no version bump, no 409 Conflict, deleted rows stay deleted). These collections are excluded from flushDirtyKeysRef/dirtyValuesRef/MASTER_SYNC_KEYS so the state blob payload now carries only settings + UI state; System Companies/Branches/Stores re-read MySQL on tab open (v2_list_companies/v2_list_branches/v2_list_stores, superadmin GLOBAL scope server-side) so the list always matches the DB; tcLoadCompanies now returns company_id per row; IDB remains a pure offline cache, never the source of truth
